> 🚧 💵 Accepted Currencies
>
> DriveWealth only accepts United States Dollars (USD) for deposits and withdrawals.
blocks.text: 💵 Accepted CurrenciesDriveWealth only accepts United States Dollars (USD) for deposits and withdrawals.

blocks.raw: Customers can fund or withdraw from their brokerage accounts through two primary methods: ACH (Automated Clearing House) transfers and Wire transfers. Each method offers distinct benefits depending on the customer's needs for speed, cost, and convenience.
blocks.text: Customers can fund or withdraw from their brokerage accounts through two primary methods: ACH (Automated Clearing House) transfers and Wire transfers. Each method offers distinct benefits depending on the customer's needs for speed, cost, and convenience.

blocks.raw: **Overview:** ACH is a widely used method for electronically moving money between bank accounts within the United States.
blocks.text: Overview: ACH is a widely used method for electronically moving money between bank accounts within the United States.

blocks.raw: **Fees:** Generally low or no fees, depending on the bank. DriveWealth charges a $0.25 fee for outbound ACH transfers
blocks.text: Fees: Generally low or no fees, depending on the bank. DriveWealth charges a $0.25 fee for outbound ACH transfers

blocks.raw: **Eligibility:** Requires a linked U.S. bank account.
blocks.text: Eligibility: Requires a linked U.S. bank account.

blocks.raw: **Overview:** Wire transfers provide a faster way to move funds electronically between financial institutions.
blocks.text: Overview: Wire transfers provide a faster way to move funds electronically between financial institutions.

blocks.raw: **Processing Time:** Same business day if initiated before the bank's cutoff time; otherwise, next business day. For Outbound wires, DriveWealth processes these same day if requested prior to 5PM ET.
blocks.text: Processing Time: Same business day if initiated before the bank's cutoff time; otherwise, next business day. For Outbound wires, DriveWealth processes these same day if requested prior to 5PM ET.

blocks.raw: **Fees:** Typically higher fees, which vary by bank. DriveWealth charges outbound WIRE transfer fee for each individual wire.
blocks.text: Fees: Typically higher fees, which vary by bank. DriveWealth charges outbound WIRE transfer fee for each individual wire.

blocks.raw: **Eligibility:** Requires accurate wiring instructions, including customer's Virtual Account Number details.
blocks.text: Eligibility: Requires accurate wiring instructions, including customer's Virtual Account Number details.
